name: @speedora/render-config
description: Stateless module (JSON-in/JSON-out): Render Fidelity & Composition Execution Engine, Phases 1-2 - Phase 1's buildEffectiveRenderConfig() builds the single EffectiveRenderConfig object a render should be driven by, from already-resolved ProcessingOptions/per-clip overrides/ops feature flags/source dimensions; Phase 2's buildOutputProfile() derives the concrete OutputProfile (width/height/fps/codec/audio) from EffectiveRenderConfig.output plus plain source media characteristics, reusing @speedora/reframe's own proven computeCropDimensions()/resolveOutputResolution() rather than re-deriving that geometry. No DB/queue/subprocess/ffprobe access at all; see root ARCHITECTURE.md and docs/ai/render-fidelity-matrix.md. Not yet consumed by any ffmpeg-facing code - apps/worker's render-clip.worker.ts logs both outputs (CONFIG_RESOLVED, OUTPUT_PROFILE_RESOLVED) alongside the existing resolveX() helpers it doesn't yet replace; see that file's own comment for the phased cutover plan.
